'''Admiral Hirken's campaign in the Northern Dependencies''' was waged in [[12,980 BBY]] as part of the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and their allies. [[Hirken]] led a spirited defense of Alsakani [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]], with the campaign extending as far as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] utilized [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to great effect, and the campaign proved decisive to the war's outcome.

==Prelude==
Between [[17,018 BBY]] and [[3017 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic member world [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies fought a total of seventeen wars known as the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] for the [[Politics/Legends|political]] and [[Galactic economy|economical]] supremacy in the Republic. The Conflicts waged before [[12,980 BBY]] saw several attempts by the two belligerent sides to secure a decisive victory through the use of battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]].<ref name="EGTW" />

However, neither Coruscant nor Alsakan were willing to overextend their military resources on offensives, and direct confrontations were rare. Eventually, the tactics employed shifted to [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of large [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] defending the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]&mdash;where both Coruscant and Alsakan lay&mdash;and fast [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] carrying out raids and protecting [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] worlds.<ref name="EGTW" />

==The campaign==
In 12,980 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], as part of the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] that had commenced approximately [[13,050 BBY|seventy years]] earlier, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hirken]], a member<ref name="EGTW" /> of a [[Hirken family|family]] that had been among the earliest settlers of Alsakan,<ref name="HanSolo">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> launched a relentless campaign to defend the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] region, which was under Alsakan's control, and the Alsakani colonies therein. During that campaign, the cruisers employed by Hirken's forces proved very valuable.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:FifthAlsakanConflict.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A battle of the campaign]]
The fighting of Hirken's campaign occurred in the Northern Dependencies' portion of the Core Worlds, the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], including engagements in the [[Battle of the Pyria system|Pyria]] and [[Battle of the Twith system|Twith systems]]. Confrontations also took place further [[spinward]], in the [[Battle of the Dachat system|Dachat]] and [[Battle of the Xa Fel system|Xa Fel systems]] of [[the Negs]] portion of the Core. The campaign even extended as far along the Alsakani-controlled [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] as the [[Battle of the Glee Anselm system|Glee Anselm]] and [[Battle of the Iridonia system|Iridonia systems]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. One of the campaign's battles, which took place in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a celestial body, saw the participation of at least thirteen [[Warship/Legends|warships]], nine of which had similar design elements yet represented several different makes.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
Although the Fifth Alsakan Conflict continued for nearly [[12,700 BBY|three more centuries]], Admiral Hirken's campaign in the Northern Dependencies decided the war's outcome. The subsequent campaigns of the Alsakan Conflicts eventually followed a set pattern of raids and ripostes taking place among Coruscant and Alsakan's colonies and being periodically interrupted by ceasefires being made in the Core Worlds.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Admiral Hirken's campaign in the Northern Dependencies was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. In the book, the campaign was depicted in an illustration by [[Darren Tan]].<ref name="EGTW" />
